title: Game Scroll
author: Robthewizz
selftext:
I created [https://game-scroll.com/](https://game-scroll.com/) because we should doom scroll games, not videos. Also games should be free, with no ads and no in-game purchases.

I started this mainly for myself and filled it with a bunch of your standard phones games.

I found this quite fun and decided to expand it by creating a game engine around it so there was a framework for adding new games.

This as worked out quite well and I have a fairly complete engine cable of making a wide range and type of games now.

There are some strict rules I have set.

1. Games must be a single Javascript file using the game scroll engine.
2. Games must not use any assets or need additional files to work.
3. Games have no network access, this is blocked, only official game scroll apis can be used.
4. Games must be fun.

Have a look at what we have now, there's some awesome games and some bad ones.

This brings me to the next part, I need you to play these games, large batches are AI created and some are just to up to the standard I think, so please heart or meh games as you go along this, we will cull all the top meh'd games each week.

I think for an app like this to proceed we need 1000 games at launch, the game feed must feel endless.

The engine has some cool features.

1. AI Tiny Brains - Small weights that help NPCs learn how you play
2. AI Voice Model - Make NPCs talk, have a radio DJ etc, there's a full mixer so easy to add effects and music.
3. \[Coming Soon\] - Real-time 3D generative model, quickly add deterministic detailed assets of anything in game.
4. Ray Tracing & Ray Regeneration
5. Super Resolution.
6. Frame Generation.
7. AR toolkit for iOS & Android.
8. Kits for everything you need.

Make a Game now - [https://game-scroll.com/make/](https://game-scroll.com/make/)

Repo: [https://github.com/robthewizzuk/game-scroll](https://github.com/robthewizzuk/game-scroll)

Play Now: [https://robthewizzuk.github.io/game-scroll/](https://robthewizzuk.github.io/game-scroll/) (Download App for Next-Gen & AR games)

Android, Mac, Windows, Linux builds: [https://github.com/robthewizzuk/game-scroll/releases](https://github.com/robthewizzuk/game-scroll/releases)

(iOS unsigned app also available) Currently focus on Android and will get an Apple Dev account soon.

Whilst I've use AI a lot to develop this and fill it with an initial set of games I do want to state that going forward whilst I encourgae you to use AI, please work on you games and make what you want and envisioned, play test it, check it's fun.

Also feel free to tweak existing games, if you think you can improve them then go ahead.

DISCLAIMER: The engine is still a work in progress, some bugs exist now and I'm working through fixing them but feel free to help and fix or just report bugs. I'm constantly building it and games may break but I will fix them.

Thanks,

Rob  
Game Scroll
